Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a concise acceptance checklist and a proposed 10-business-day close sprint so your team can validate performance and risk controls without long ramp commitments. The goal here is to make the evaluation deterministic: if the checks pass we move to a canary dedicated instance and lock in pricing/terms. If they fail, we capture the failure modes and agree next steps.

Attached: cedarbridge_map_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones) and rb_validation_checklist_v2.md (detailed acceptance tests). I also added a calendar file for the proposed sprint kickoff (sprint-timeline.ics).

High-level flow:
- Day 0: kickoff + environment access + dataset sampling
- Days 1–4: functional smoke tests + latency/throughput baseline (our pre-baked workloads)
- Days 5–7: accuracy/quality checks on your sample prompts + regression monitoring
- Days 8–9: security / audit trail verification (KMS integration, log export)
- Day 10: signoff or redline with remediation plan

Key acceptance gates (short):
1) Latency SLO: 95th <= 180ms for 1k token median prompt under the agreed concurrency profile
2) Cost delta: cost per 1k tokens within 20% of estimated MAP baseline
3) Functional parity: top-line generation quality on the example prompt set (concordance >= 92% vs baseline eval)
4) Security: encrypted at rest + audit log forwarding to your SIEM for 7 days

Quick asks from your side:
- Confirm the kickoff window (we proposed Thu May 7, 10:00am PT)
- Confirm which three canonical prompts you want included in the quality check
- Point us to the account in your identity provider that we should add for test access

If that looks good I'll send the MAP as a living doc and assign owners.

Thanks,
Connor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
